## Article 1: OpenAI Unveils o3: The First AI Model Capable of Multi-Day Autonomous Reasoning
URL: https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/articles/openai-o3-reasoning-breakthrough-system-2-thinking.html
Date: 2026-11-21
Author: Paresh Padsala

Summary:
OpenAI has officially announced o3, its next-generation reasoning model family that scales test-time compute to unprecedented levels. Moving past simple conversational auto-regression, o3 incorporates autonomous multi-step tree-search verification, achieving 87.5% on ARC-AGI benchmarks and competing at international programming olympiad levels.

Key Technical Highlights:
1. System 2 Reasoning Architecture: Unlike System 1 models (e.g. GPT-4o) that predict tokens in a single forward pass, o3 employs deliberate test-time compute scaling using Monte Carlo tree search, internal reflection tokens, and multi-hypothesis backtracking.
2. ARC-AGI Benchmark: Scored 87.5% under standardized semi-private evaluation, crossing the threshold of human-level abstract visual puzzle solving.
3. Test-Time Compute vs Pre-training Compute: Demonstrates that allocating 10,000x more compute at inference time yields greater reasoning gains than a 10x larger model evaluated with single-pass sampling.
4. Economic Realities: Inference costs range from $0.15 for light queries up to $1,000+ for multi-hour deep research sessions involving billions of tokens of internal scratchpad exploration.
